findings.issue: A uint32[] packs 8 elements per slot; the text never prints element i as stor10[i]: reads are masked shifts of stor[i / 8 + sha3(10)], writes are whole-slot mask arithmetic, and the storage-to-memory copy of the getters is a while loop whose byte-offset bookkeeping is unreadable.
findings.rule: For a dynamic array at slot p whose accesses are slot sha3(p) + i / k, bits w * (i % k) (k = 256 / w), declare 'array of uintw' and print reads and masked writes as p[i]; a loop copying p[0..n) into consecutive memory words is one copy line 'mem[d len 32 * n] = p[0 len n]'.

notes: Reviewed against Cellar.sol and its CellarWithOracle / BalancerFlashLoans / MultiAssetDeposit / NativeSupport layers, ERC20/ERC4626 (solmate), Auth, Uint32Array, SafeTransferLib, Math. The pack's 'Reaches' lists include PriceRouter, Registry, ERC4626SharePriceOracle, OracleLibrary and TickMath functions; they are external contracts called through interfaces, not inlined here, so their loops (PriceRouter._getValues) are not counted. deposit, mint, redeem, withdraw, multiAssetDeposit, receiveFlashLoan, totalAssets, totalAssetsWithdrawable, maxWithdraw/maxRedeem, the position-management functions and the small owner functions were read; callOnAdaptor (950 lines) and cachePriceRouter (650 lines) by structure (both contain the totalAssets computation before and after, as in the source). Checked: nonReentrant lock/unlock on bit 192 of slot 8, shares computed with the pre-transfer totalSupply, mulDivDown/Up preconditions and the (p - 1) / d * bool(p) + bool(p) rounding, Uint32Array add/remove bounds, the checked exponentiation helper for 10**decimals. Loops: 10 source loops (multicall - shown 'while True' with the bound inside -, receiveFlashLoan, the three loops of _calculateTotalAssetsOrTotalAssetsWithdrawable in each caller, _makeAdaptorCalls outer and inner, _withdrawInOrder, Uint32Array.add and remove) all shown as while; implicit: storage-bytes adaptorData copies (21), packed uint32[] copies (2), ABI encodes and memory copies (P7 45 in all), the exponentiation helper (2). P11: Panic(50) checks implied by the loop bound, 't - 1 > t' re-checked in every iteration of Uint32Array.remove after it was checked before the loop. The asset is an immutable (artifact: 'call 0x0.transferFrom'). No execution run: no semantic suspicion remained.
summary: Faithful on every path read, all loops present; readability suffers mainly from the packed uint32[] position arrays printed as raw slot and mask arithmetic, the unresolved free-memory buffers of adaptor delegatecalls and custom-error reverts, and unsplit packed slots 8 and 16.
